target_customer: Brazilian companies that need to deploy and manage many employee mobile lines
problem: Corporate mobile lines in Brazil are bought from large carriers with little software for onboarding, HR and ERP integration. Salvy resells network access as an MVNO with a management layer.
business_model: MVNO subscription per line (R$29.90 to R$99.90 per line per month on the site) plus software features
product_category: B2B mobile carrier (MVNO) with management software

founders.name: Artur Negrao
founders.background_notes: YC page says the founders worked together for years at Nubank and EBANX; individual employer not stated for him.

technical_complexity.rationale: Runs on a host network (TIM) as an MVNO, so the hard parts are billing, provisioning, eSIM and HRIS or ERP integration rather than building a network.

defensibility.rationale: Hosts lines on wholesale network access that others can also rent; number porting and integrations add moderate lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A third party profile lists these carriers as B2B competitors without dates; no evidence found that they copied Salvy's software layer.

market_need_then: The YC description cites 55 million B2B mobile lines in Brazil and says network quality is similar across carriers. Early customers were SMBs; sources say it began as telephony as an employee benefit before focusing on corporate lines.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, conversational Brazilian Portuguese that contrasts Salvy with old carriers (no red tape, no lock-in)

branding.brand_signature: The name is used almost as a verb in customer copy

brand_strength.rationale: Clear friendly voice and a short name, and Brazilian startup press covers it, but no evidence of a mascot, community or viral brand assets.

outcome_analysis: Salvy is a Curitiba MVNO selling business mobile lines. Founders from Nubank and EBANX raised a seed in February 2024 with YC and SaaSholic, followed by a larger extension reported by Brazilian press after Demo Day, and the company reports more than 1,800 business customers and 20,000 lines. It is active with product launches into 2026, so the story is steady growth without an exit.
notes: Company blog title states a $1M seed; one summary mentions 5 million reais, so the USD figure follows the headline. Extension reported as R$10M, bringing total to R$15M per Startups.com.br; date not stated in the snippet and USD not converted. Pre-seed of about R$1M from angels (including Fiamma Zarife) is mentioned in press with no date, so not recorded as a round. CB Insights lists $3.04M total and a $1.94M seed on 2024-05-13, conflicting; unverified. Founding year 2022 per Endeavor, 2023 per another aggregator. Founder education not found. Competitor list empty because the only source naming carriers is an undated 2026 profile.
